name: HYDRO CLEAN (BIS)
summary: The Hydro Clean RO Water Purifier is designed to provide safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water for homes using brackish water. Powered by advanced Reverse Osmosis (RO) technology , it effectively removes dissolved impurities, excess TDS, bacteria, and harmful contaminants.
intro: HYDRO CLEAN is a compact countertop RO water purifier designed for brackish water. With TFC membrane technology, multi-stage filtration, 7-litre storage, and 12 LPH purification capacity, it delivers clean and purified drinking water with reliable performance.
